issue.title: Allow to switch into different arrow types when using "Tab" switcher when bound to element/s or text
issue.author: zsviczian
issue.body_markdown: Is it by design that if either ends of an arrow are bound to an element the "TAB" shape switcher does not work?

comments.author: Mrazator
comments.body_markdown:
It is, when talking about line <-> arrow, but it might change in the future.

The issue is that currently, a line is not bindable to other shapes, so switching into a line would unbind the arrow from other shapes, which would be unexpected in most cases.

Similarly, we don't allow switching to line when arrows have a label.

---

Switching between different arrow types (sharp / curved / angled) should still be possible, unclear why it wasn't added.

comments.author: zsviczian
comments.body_markdown: yeah, the line I can understand. I was trying to switch between arrow types, which is possible on the element properties panel. Maybe we could not show the line option if the arrow is bound to an element.

comments.author: dwelle
comments.body_markdown: Yep, let's do this (not showing the line option).
